vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Liquibase does not expose a Netty DNS listener.

ratings.justification: Server-side DNS vulnerability. Liquibase never accepts inbound DNS connections; Netty DNS codec is only used for outbound resolution.

analysis.detail: Netty DNS codec vulnerability fixed in 4.1.133.Final / 4.2.13.Final. Liquibase is a database migration CLI tool that does not run a DNS server or expose any DNS-processing listener. Netty is a transitive dependency from Azure SDK, Cassandra driver, and MongoDB driver — used only as a client-side transport. Netty's DNS codec is used internally for resolving outbound hostnames; no inbound DNS requests are accepted.

vulnerabilities.description: Memory leak in Netty's DNS codec when processing malicious DNS response packets containing invalid domain names. The record decoder fails to release allocated ByteBuf resources before the IDNA-validation exception is thrown, allowing incremental memory exhaustion through sustained malicious DNS responses.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Requires a compromised or malicious DNS resolution path, which lies outside Liquibase's outbound-client threat model.

ratings.justification: Requires a compromised or malicious DNS server able to forge responses to Liquibase's own outbound resolution queries.

analysis.detail: Netty's DNS record decoder fails to release allocated ByteBuf resources before throwing on domain names that violate IDNA rules, leaking memory per malformed record. Unlike the server-side Netty DNS codec findings above, this path is reached during Liquibase's own outbound DNS resolution, but only triggers when the DNS server answering that resolution (or an on-path attacker able to forge responses) returns malformed records. This requires a compromised or malicious DNS resolution path — an attacker already in a position to forge DNS responses to Liquibase's outbound queries could achieve more direct impact (e.g. redirecting database connections) than a gradual memory leak. No CVE has been assigned to this advisory at the time of assessment. Netty is a transitive dependency from Azure SDK, Cassandra driver, and MongoDB driver — used only as a client-side transport for outbound connections.
